The '''Jakelia system''' was a part of the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Jakelian tuft-oak]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]]<ref name="Incredible">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> and the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Jakelian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="EGTW" /> It was also the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Jakelian knife-dance]],<ref name="Cestus">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref> a form of melee combat<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|135|Jakelian knife-dance}}</ref> that also possessed some characteristics of dancing.<ref name="Cestus" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jakelia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-7.<ref name="TEA" />
